summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload unrelated to the package's stated purpose
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is obfuscated with javascript-obfuscator style mangling (`_0xNNNNNN` identifiers, keyword lookup tables) that conceals a chain which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases and then uses that freshly-fetched runtime to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (string-array indirection via `WV8StW`, a large numeric string table `n7gIxM`, mangled identifier lists) whose name and contents have no relation to a transcripts SDK. The Bun-only bundle header ensures the payload runs only under the dropped alternate runtime, evading Node-based inspection. The result is that installing this package executes attacker-authored, opaque code on the installer host at install time, delivered through an alternate-runtime dropper pattern in which the runtime install is a legitimate vendor download but the code executed under it is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
